blocks.text: 125 | Musaph for the New Year | 125

who once ruled, will throw off their raiment, they will offer praise and pay homage to the Lord when He will reign. Those called by the Lord shall reign and after Him will they follow, upright will they walk and at their head will He reign. The hidden secret (of the redemption) is prepared for this day, recorded for the time and season on which in retribution He will reign. The Faithful Shepherd, when He comes from Teman, the wind will roar in Teman, in Gilead will He reign. The heavenly Shinanim and the assembly of angels will utter a song of praise in the heights, for He will reign. The depths of the earth, the marvellous heavenly bodies, the roaring mass of creatures, rejoice when He will reign. Established shall be the throne of him who is like the sun (the anointed), his name existed even before the sun, his appearance is as the going out of the sun, in God's realm will He reign.

blocks.text: שוא God hates falsehood, yet it is upon our tongue; He demands truth, but it is not there; and, therefore, distant became the Kingdom. Almighty, remove guilt from Thy hosts that they may cry out to Thee with the Teruah of the Kingdom.

blocks.text: 126 | Musaph for the New Year | 126

ככתוב As it is written in Thy Torah: 'The Lord will reign for ever and ever.' And it was said: 'And He observed no wrong in Jacob nor did He see trouble in Israel, the Lord His God is with him and the royal Teruah within him.' And it was said: 'And He became King in Yeshurun when the heads of the people assembled together with the tribes of Israel'. And in Thy holy words it is written saying: 'For dominion is the Lord's and He is ruler over nations'. And it was said: 'The Lord has reigned, clothed in majesty, the Lord has clothed Himself in strength. He has girded Himself, the world is firmly founded, it does not totter.' And it was said: 'Lift up your heads, O gates and lift yourselves up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? He is the Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in war. Lift up your heads, O gates, lift up, O portals of eternity, so that the King of glory may enter. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of Hosts, He is the King of glory, Selah'. And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying: 'Thus says the Lord, the King of Israel and its redeemer, the Lord of Hosts: I am the first and I am the last and apart from Me there is no God'. And it was said: 'Deliverers shall ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau and dominion shall be the Lord's . And it was said: 'And the Lord shall be King over all the earth, on that day will the Lord be One and His Name One'. And in Thy Torah it is written saying: 'Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One'.
uncertainties: After 'the Lord's' the closing quotation mark is missing and a space stands before the period ('Lord's .'). Kept as printed.
